brief:
Israeli forces conducted a raid on al-Mughayyir village northeast of Ramallah on Wednesday evening, the Shehab wire agency reported. The incursion resulted in multiple residents sustaining suffocation injuries during the operation.

The circumstances surrounding the raid, including its duration, scale, and any stated military objective, remained unclear. No immediate statement was issued regarding the purpose of the forces' entry into the village or the extent of their presence on the ground.
